ADAPTABLE_TRIAL_COST_PER_PATIENT.description: Cost per patient in ADAPTABLE trial ($14M PCORI grant / 15,076 patients). Note: This is the direct grant cost; true cost including in-kind may be 10-40% higher.

ADAPTABLE_TRIAL_PATIENTS.description: Patients enrolled in ADAPTABLE trial (PCORnet 2016-2019). Enrolled across 40 clinical sites. Precise count from trial completion records.

ADAPTABLE_TRIAL_TOTAL_COST.description: PCORI grant for ADAPTABLE trial (2016-2019). Note: Direct funding only; total costs including site overhead and in-kind contributions from health systems may be higher.

ADDITIONAL_DRUGS_FROM_COST_ELIMINATION.description: Additional drug approvals per year when Phase 2/3 cost barrier eliminated. Assumes valley-of-death compounds (abandoned due to cost) would have similar success rate to funded compounds.

ALLOCATION_DECISION_SPREAD.description: Return spread between the best and worst major asset-class sectors (biotech vs. coal, growth vs. value, emerging vs. declining). The accuracy advantage of crowds over experts is multiplied by this spread to estimate the allocation alpha from wishocratic decision-making.

ANNUAL_TERRORISM_DEATH_RISK_DENOMINATOR.description: Annual probability of being killed by terrorism expressed as '1 in X'. An American's annual odds of dying in a terrorist attack are approximately 1 in 30 million.

ANNUAL_WORKING_HOURS.description: Standard annual working hours globally. Approximately 40 hours/week x 50 weeks. ILO estimates range from 1,800-2,200 across countries; 2,000 is conventional.

ANTIDEPRESSANT_TRIAL_EXCLUSION_RATE.description: Mean exclusion rate in antidepressant trials (86.1% of real-world patients excluded)

APOCALYPSE_MARKUP.description: The Apocalypse Markup: total military spending beyond the Price of Apocalypse. The amount governments spend above what is needed to trigger nuclear winter and end civilization once.

APOCALYPSE_MARKUP_MULTIPLIER.description: How many times total military spending exceeds the Price of Apocalypse. The markup multiplier on the cost of ending civilization.

APPROVED_DRUG_DISEASE_PAIRINGS.description: Unique approved drug-disease pairings (FDA-approved uses, midpoint of 1,500-2,000 range)

AVG_LIFE_EXTENSION_PER_BENEFICIARY.description: Average years of life extension per person saved by pharmaceutical interventions. Assumption used to convert life-years saved to approximate lives saved. Based on Lichtenberg's methodology where life-years are calculated from Years of Life Lost (YLL) reductions.

BASELINE_LIVES_SAVED_ANNUAL.description: Baseline annual lives saved by pharmaceuticals (conservative aggregate)

BED_NETS_COST_PER_DALY.description: GiveWell cost per DALY for insecticide-treated bed nets (midpoint estimate, range $78-100). DALYs (Disability-Adjusted Life Years) measure disease burden by combining years of life lost and years lived with disability. Bed nets prevent malaria deaths and are considered a gold standard benchmark for cost-effective global health interventions - if an intervention costs less per DALY than bed nets, it's exceptionally cost-effective. GiveWell synthesizes peer-reviewed academic research with transparent, rigorous methodology and extensive external expert review.

BEST_PRACTICE_LIFE_EXPECTANCY_GAIN.description: Gap between current global life expectancy and the best life expectancy achieved by a major country today. Used as a non-arbitrary governance/public-health uplift benchmark rather than capping Wishonia at today's global average.

BULLETS_FIRED_PER_KILL_IRAQ_AFGHANISTAN.description: Rounds of small-arms ammunition fired per insurgent killed in Iraq and Afghanistan. Based on GAO figures: ~6 billion rounds expended 2002-2005. Calculated by military researcher John Pike of GlobalSecurity.org.

BULLETS_PER_PERSON_ANNUAL.description: Number of bullets per person on Earth that could be purchased annually with the global military budget. A purchasing power metric illustrating the scale of military spending.

BULLET_COST_556_NATO.description: Cost per round of 5.56x45mm NATO ammunition (military bulk procurement). Based on U.S. military procurement contracts for M855 ball ammunition. Civilian retail floor is ~$0.37; $0.40 is a conservative midpoint.

CAMPAIGN_COMMUNITY_ORGANIZING.description: Community organizing and ambassador program budget

CAMPAIGN_DEFENSE_LOBBYIST_BUDGET.description: Budget for co-opting defense industry lobbyists

CAMPAIGN_PILOT_PROGRAMS.description: Pilot program testing in small countries

CAREGIVER_ANNUAL_VALUE_TOTAL.description: Total annual value of unpaid caregiving in US

CAREGIVER_COST_ANNUAL.description: Annual cost of unpaid caregiving (replacement cost method)

CAREGIVER_COUNT_US.description: Number of unpaid caregivers in US

CAREGIVER_HOURS_PER_MONTH.description: Average monthly hours of unpaid family caregiving in US

CAREGIVER_VALUE_PER_HOUR_SIMPLE.description: Estimated replacement cost per hour of caregiving

CELL_THERAPY_APPROACHES.description: Distinct cell therapy approaches (CAR-T variants, iPSCs, MSCs, organoids)

CHAIN_DISMISS_PROBABILITY.description: Probability someone dismisses the idea without engaging (the 'institutionalization rate')

CHAIN_EFFECTIVE_R.description: Effective reproduction number per cascade generation: fraction of viewers who share (5%) x average forwards per sharer (3). CI spans pessimistic (2% x 2 = 0.04) to optimistic (10% x 8 = 0.80).

CHAIN_ENGAGE_PROBABILITY.description: Probability someone engages with the idea (1 - dismissal rate)

CHAIN_EXPECTED_ENGAGED_IMPLEMENTERS.description: Expected number of implementers who engage (orbit reached x engagement rate x implementer count)

CHAIN_HORIZON_YEARS.description: Conservative upper bound for cascade propagation (social media cascades propagate in weeks; 3 years allows for slower channels and multiple cascade waves)

CHAIN_IMPLEMENTER_ORBIT_SIZE.description: Information-orbit size per implementer: people whose recommendation would reach them (staff, advisors, active social media feeds, professional contacts). Lower bound: Dunbar's 150; upper: corporate C-suite intake funnel.

CHAIN_INITIAL_AUDIENCE.description: Conservative initial audience size (readers, website visitors, conference attendees)

CHAIN_P_AT_LEAST_ONE_ENGAGES.description: Probability at least one implementer engages (information diffusion only; dominant strategy proof handles action)

CHAIN_P_ENCOUNTER_DIRECT_10YR.description: Probability a given implementer's information orbit is reached by the content cascade

CHAIN_P_NO_IMPLEMENTER_ENGAGES.description: Probability that NO implementer engages (all orbits missed or all dismiss)

CHAIN_WORLD_LEADER_COUNT.description: Number of sovereign heads of state/government

CHILDHOOD_VACCINATION_ANNUAL_BENEFIT.description: Estimated annual global economic benefit from childhood vaccination programs (measles, polio, etc.)

CHILDHOOD_VACCINATION_COST_PER_DALY.description: Estimated cost per DALY for US childhood vaccination programs. Note: US cost-effectiveness studies primarily use cost per QALY (Quality-Adjusted Life Year) rather than cost per DALY. This estimate is derived from program costs and benefits for comparison purposes only.

CHILDHOOD_VACCINATION_ROI.description: Return on investment from childhood vaccination programs

CHRONIC_DISEASE_DISABILITY_WEIGHT.description: Disability weight for untreated chronic conditions (WHO Global Burden of Disease)

CHRONIC_DISEASE_TREATED_PATIENTS_ANNUAL.description: Estimated unique patients receiving chronic disease treatment annually. Derived from IQVIA days of therapy (1.28T) divided by 365 days divided by 2.5 average medications per patient times 70% post-1962 drugs.

CLINICAL_TRIAL_COST_PER_APPROVED_DRUG.description: Annual clinical trial spending per approved drug (trials only, excluding other R&D costs like discovery, preclinical, manufacturing)

CLINICAL_TRIAL_COST_PER_PARTICIPANT_ANNU.description: Average annual cost per clinical trial participant (total spending ÷ participants)

COMBINATION_THERAPY_DISEASE_SPACE.description: Total combination therapy space (pairwise drug combinations × diseases). Standard in oncology, HIV, cardiology.

COMBINATION_THERAPY_PAIRS.description: Unique pairwise drug combinations from known safe compounds (n choose 2)

CONCENTRATED_INTEREST_SECTOR_MARKET_CAP_.description: Estimated combined market capitalization of concentrated interest opposition (defense, fossil fuel, etc.)

CONTRIBUTION_DALYS_PER_PCT_POINT.description: DALYs averted per percentage point of implementation probability shift. One percent of total DALYs from eliminating trial capacity bottleneck and efficacy lag.

CONTRIBUTION_EV_PER_PCT_POINT_TREATY.description: Personal expected value per percentage point of implementation probability shift under Treaty Trajectory. One percent of the per-capita lifetime income gain.

CONTRIBUTION_EV_PER_PCT_POINT_TREATY_BLE.description: Blended personal expected value per percentage point of implementation probability shift under Treaty Trajectory.

CONTRIBUTION_EV_PER_PCT_POINT_WISHONIA.description: Personal expected value per percentage point of implementation probability shift under Wishonia Trajectory. One percent of the per-capita lifetime income gain.

CONTRIBUTION_EV_PER_PCT_POINT_WISHONIA_B.description: Blended personal expected value per percentage point of implementation probability shift under Wishonia Trajectory.

CONTRIBUTION_LIVES_SAVED_PER_PCT_POINT.description: Lives saved per percentage point of implementation probability shift. One percent of total lives saved from eliminating trial capacity bottleneck and efficacy lag.

CONTRIBUTION_SUFFERING_HOURS_PER_PCT_POI.description: Suffering hours prevented per percentage point of implementation probability shift. One percent of total suffering hours from eliminating trial capacity bottleneck and efficacy lag.

CONVENTIONAL_RETIREMENT_HORIZON_MULTIPLE.description: Compound multiple for conventional retirement investing over the PRIZE pool resolution horizon (tied to the destructive economy 50% threshold year).

CONVENTIONAL_RETIREMENT_RETURN.description: Average retail after-fee return on conventional retirement portfolios (60/40 stock/bond mix, ~1% advisory fees, ~0.4% fund fees). Used as the opportunity cost comparison: depositors are LOSING money by NOT participating in the Prize Fund.

CPI_MULTIPLIER_1980_TO_2024.description: CPI inflation multiplier from 1980 to 2024 (280.48% cumulative inflation)

CROWD_DECISION_ACCURACY.description: Crowd accuracy on Who Wants to Be a Millionaire ask-the-audience lifeline. Studio audience picked the correct answer 91% of the time (Surowiecki 2004). Used as lower bound for wishocratic allocation accuracy.

CUMULATIVE_MILITARY_IN_GOVT_TRIAL_YEARS.description: Cumulative military spending since 1913 expressed in equivalent years of government clinical trial spending ($170T / $4.5B per year)

CUMULATIVE_MILITARY_SPENDING_ALL_HISTORY.description: Cumulative global military spending across all recorded history in constant 2024 dollars. Fed era ($170T) + 19th century ($3T) + pre-1800 GDP-share estimate ($4-20T). Range: $150-225T. 75% was spent after 1945.

CUMULATIVE_MILITARY_SPENDING_FED_ERA.description: Cumulative global military spending since 1913 (Fed era) in constant 2024 dollars. Built from: SIPRI 1988-2024 ($65-72T), Cold War 1946-1987 ($50-70T reconstructed), WWI+WWII+interwar ($33T from Harrison). Range: $150-190T.

CURRENT_ACTIVE_TRIALS.description: Current active trials at any given time (3-5 year duration)

CURRENT_CLINICAL_TRIAL_PARTICIPATION_RAT.description: Current clinical trial participation rate (0.06% of population)

CURRENT_COMBINATION_EXPLORATION_YEARS.description: Years to test all pairwise drug combinations at current trial capacity. Combination therapy is standard in oncology, HIV, cardiology.

CURRENT_DRUG_APPROVALS_PER_YEAR.description: Average annual new drug approvals globally

CURRENT_KNOWN_SAFE_EXPLORATION_YEARS.description: Years to test all known safe drug-disease combinations at current global trial capacity

CURRENT_PATIENT_PARTICIPATION_RATE.description: Current patient participation rate in clinical trials (0.08% = 1.9M participants / 2.4B disease patients)

CURRENT_TOTAL_EXPLORATION_YEARS.description: Years to test all therapeutic combinations (known safe + emerging modalities) at current capacity

CURRENT_TRAJECTORY_AVG_INCOME_YEAR_15.description: Average income (GDP per capita) at year 15 under current trajectory.

CURRENT_TRAJECTORY_AVG_INCOME_YEAR_20.description: Average income (GDP per capita) at year 20 under current trajectory trajectory.

CURRENT_TRAJECTORY_CUMULATIVE_LIFETIME_I.description: Cumulative per-capita income over an average remaining lifespan under current trajectory baseline trajectory. Uses the implied per-capita baseline CAGR from 2025 to 2045.
CURRENT_TRAJECTORY_CUMULATIVE_LIFETIME_I.formula: GLOBAL_AVG_INCOME_2025 * (1+g_pc,base) * ((1+g_pc,base)^T - 1) / g_pc,base, where g_pc,base is implied by CURRENT_TRAJECTORY_AVG_INCOME_YEAR_20

CURRENT_TRAJECTORY_GDP_YEAR_15.description: Global GDP at year 15 under status-quo current trajectory growth.

CURRENT_TRAJECTORY_GDP_YEAR_20.description: Global GDP at year 20 under status-quo current trajectory growth.

CURRENT_TRIALS_PER_YEAR.description: Current global clinical trials per year

CURRENT_TRIAL_ABANDONMENT_RATE.description: Current trial abandonment rate (40% never complete)

CURRENT_TRIAL_SLOTS_AVAILABLE.description: Annual global clinical trial participants (IQVIA 2022: 1.9M post-COVID normalization)

DCT_PLATFORM_FUNDING_MEDIUM.description: Mid-range funding for commercial DCT platform

DEFENSE_SECTOR_RETENTION_PCT.description: Percentage of budget defense sector keeps under 1% treaty

DEMOCIDE_TOTAL_20TH_CENTURY.description: Total people murdered by governments worldwide, 1900-1999 (Rummel's democide estimate)

DESTRUCTIVE_ECONOMY_25PCT_YEAR.description: Calendar year when the destructive economy (military + cybercrime) reaches 25% of GDP at current growth rates. Historical precedent suggests societies become unstable when extraction rates exceed 20-30% of economic output.
DESTRUCTIVE_ECONOMY_25PCT_YEAR.formula: DESTRUCTIVE_ECONOMY_BASE_YEAR + ln(0.25 / DESTRUCTIVE_PCT_GDP) / ln(1 + DESTRUCTIVE_GROWTH - GDP_GROWTH)

DESTRUCTIVE_ECONOMY_35PCT_YEAR.description: Calendar year when the destructive economy (military + cybercrime) reaches 35% of GDP at current growth rates. Historical evidence from the Soviet Union, Yugoslavia, Argentina, and Zimbabwe shows that total extractive burdens of 35-45% consistently trigger self-reinforcing death spirals. This is the empirically-derived terminal parasitic load threshold.
DESTRUCTIVE_ECONOMY_35PCT_YEAR.formula: DESTRUCTIVE_ECONOMY_BASE_YEAR + ln(0.35 / DESTRUCTIVE_PCT_GDP) / ln(1 + DESTRUCTIVE_GROWTH - GDP_GROWTH)

DESTRUCTIVE_ECONOMY_50PCT_YEAR.description: Calendar year when the destructive economy (military + cybercrime) reaches 50% of GDP at current growth rates. At that point, half of all economic activity is destructive, so stealing starts to beat creating for individuals, firms, and states because whatever gets created gets looted fast enough to kill productive investment.
DESTRUCTIVE_ECONOMY_50PCT_YEAR.formula: DESTRUCTIVE_ECONOMY_BASE_YEAR + ln(0.50 / DESTRUCTIVE_PCT_GDP) / ln(1 + DESTRUCTIVE_GROWTH - GDP_GROWTH)

DESTRUCTIVE_ECONOMY_BASE_YEAR.description: Base year for destructive economy projections. All threshold timelines are measured from this year.

DEWORMING_COST_PER_DALY.description: Cost per DALY for deworming programs (range $28-82, midpoint estimate). GiveWell notes this 2011 estimate is outdated and their current methodology focuses on long-term income effects rather than short-term health DALYs.

DFDA_ANNUAL_OPEX.description: Total annual Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment operational costs (sum of all components: platform + staff + infra + regulatory + community)

DFDA_ANNUAL_TRIAL_FUNDING.description: Assumed annual funding for dFDA pragmatic clinical trials (~$21.8B/year). Source-agnostic: could come from military reallocation, philanthropy, or government appropriation.

DFDA_BENEFIT_RD_ONLY_ANNUAL.description: Annual Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment benefit from R&D savings (trial cost reduction, secondary component)

DFDA_COMBINED_TREATMENT_SPEEDUP_MULTIPLI.description: Combined speedup factor for treatment discovery from dFDA. Trial capacity multiplier times valley of death rescue multiplier. Diseases that would take T years to get first treatment now take T/speedup years.

DFDA_DIRECT_FUNDING_COST_PER_DALY.description: Cost per DALY at direct funding level for the therapeutic space exploration period. Still highly cost-effective vs bed nets.

DFDA_DIRECT_FUNDING_QUEUE_CLEARANCE_NPV.description: NPV of annual direct funding for the therapeutic space exploration period. Funding period equals exploration time (queue clearance years at given capacity multiplier). After exploration completes, the full timeline shift benefit is realized.
DFDA_DIRECT_FUNDING_QUEUE_CLEARANCE_NPV.formula: ANNUAL_FUNDING × [(1 - (1 + r)^-T) / r] where T = exploration time

DFDA_DIRECT_FUNDING_ROI_TRIAL_CAPACITY_P.description: ROI from directly funding pragmatic clinical trials over the therapeutic space exploration period.

DFDA_DIRECT_FUNDING_VS_BED_NETS_MULTIPLI.description: How many times more cost-effective direct funding of medical research is vs bed nets.

DFDA_EFFICACY_LAG_ELIMINATION_DALYS.description: Total Disability-Adjusted Life Years lost from disease eradication delay (PRIMARY estimate)

DFDA_EFFICACY_LAG_ELIMINATION_DEATHS_AVE.description: Total eventually avoidable deaths from delaying disease eradication by 8.2 years (PRIMARY estimate, conservative). Excludes fundamentally unavoidable deaths (primarily accidents ~7.9%).

DFDA_EFFICACY_LAG_ELIMINATION_ECONOMIC_V.description: Total economic loss from delaying disease eradication by 8.2 years (PRIMARY estimate, 2024 USD). Values global DALYs at standardized US/International normative rate ($150k) rather than local ability-to-pay, representing the full human capital loss.

DFDA_EFFICACY_LAG_ELIMINATION_YLD.description: Years Lived with Disability during disease eradication delay (PRIMARY estimate)

DFDA_EFFICACY_LAG_ELIMINATION_YLL.description: Years of Life Lost from disease eradication delay deaths (PRIMARY estimate)

DFDA_FIRST_TREATMENTS_PER_YEAR.description: Diseases per year receiving their first effective treatment with dFDA. Scales proportionally with trial capacity multiplier.

DFDA_KNOWN_SAFE_EXPLORATION_YEARS.description: Years to test all known safe drug-disease combinations with dFDA trial capacity

DFDA_MAX_TRIAL_CAPACITY_MULTIPLIER_PHYSI.description: Physical upper bound on trial-capacity multiplier from participant availability. Even with unlimited funding, annual trial enrollment cannot exceed willing participant pool.

DFDA_NET_SAVINGS_RD_ONLY_ANNUAL.description: Annual net savings from R&D cost reduction only (gross savings minus operational costs, excludes regulatory delay value)

DFDA_NPV_ADOPTION_RAMP_YEARS.description: Years to reach full Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment adoption

DFDA_NPV_ANNUAL_OPEX.description: Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Core framework annual opex (midpoint of $11-26.5M)

DFDA_NPV_ANNUAL_OPEX_TOTAL.description: Total NPV annual opex (Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment core + DIH initiatives)

DFDA_NPV_BENEFIT_RD_ONLY.description: NPV of Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment R&D savings only with 5-year adoption ramp (10-year horizon, most conservative financial estimate)

DFDA_NPV_NET_BENEFIT_RD_ONLY.description: NPV net benefit using R&D savings only (benefits minus costs)

DFDA_NPV_PV_ANNUAL_OPEX.description: Present value of annual opex over 10 years (NPV formula)

DFDA_NPV_TOTAL_COST.description: Total NPV cost (upfront + PV of annual opex)

DFDA_NPV_UPFRONT_COST.description: Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Core framework build cost

DFDA_NPV_UPFRONT_COST_TOTAL.description: Total NPV upfront costs (Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment core + DIH initiatives)

DFDA_OBSERVATIONAL_COST_PER_PATIENT.description: Order-of-magnitude estimate for Stage 1 observational signal detection (PIS calculation). Validated by FDA Sentinel benchmark (~$1/patient/year for similar drug safety analysis at 100M+ scale). True cost varies with scale and complexity; exact value less important than order-of-magnitude difference vs pragmatic trials (~$500-929/patient) and traditional Phase 3 (~$41,000/patient).

DFDA_OPEX_COMMUNITY.description: Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment community support costs

DFDA_OPEX_INFRASTRUCTURE.description: Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment infrastructure costs (cloud, security)

DFDA_OPEX_PCT_OF_TREATY_FUNDING.description: Percentage of treaty funding allocated to Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment framework overhead

DFDA_OPEX_PLATFORM_MAINTENANCE.description: Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment maintenance costs

DFDA_OPEX_REGULATORY.description: Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment regulatory coordination costs

DFDA_OPEX_STAFF.description: Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment staff costs (minimal, AI-assisted)

DFDA_PATIENTS_FUNDABLE_ANNUALLY.description: Number of patients fundable annually from dFDA funding at pragmatic trial cost. Source-agnostic counterpart of DIH_PATIENTS_FUNDABLE_ANNUALLY.

DFDA_PRAGMATIC_TRIAL_COST_PER_PATIENT.description: dFDA pragmatic trial cost per patient. Uses ADAPTABLE trial ($929) as DELIBERATELY CONSERVATIVE central estimate. Ramsberg & Platt (2018) reviewed 108 embedded pragmatic trials; 64 with cost data had median of only $97/patient - our estimate may overstate costs by 10x. Confidence interval spans meta-analysis median to complex chronic disease trials.

DFDA_QUEUE_CLEARANCE_YEARS.description: Years to explore the entire therapeutic search space with dFDA implementation. At increased discovery rate, finding first treatments for all currently untreatable diseases takes ~36 years instead of ~443.

DFDA_RD_SAVINGS_DAILY.description: Daily R&D savings from trial cost reduction (opportunity cost of delay)

DFDA_ROI_RD_ONLY.description: ROI from Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment R&D savings only (10-year NPV, most conservative estimate)

DFDA_STORAGE_COST_BACKUP_PER_PATIENT_MON.description: Backup and redundancy cost per patient per month. For data safety and compliance.

DFDA_STORAGE_COST_COMPUTE_PER_PATIENT_MO.description: Compute and API cost per patient per month. For data processing, correlation analysis, and PIS calculation.

DFDA_STORAGE_COST_DATABASE_PER_PATIENT_M.description: Database cost per patient per month. For structured data storage and querying.

DFDA_STORAGE_COST_RAW_PER_PATIENT_MONTHL.description: Raw cloud storage cost per patient per month. Based on standard cloud storage rates for ~1GB patient data.

DFDA_STORAGE_COST_TOTAL_PER_PATIENT_ANNU.description: Total infrastructure cost per patient per year. Monthly cost × 12.

DFDA_STORAGE_COST_TOTAL_PER_PATIENT_MONT.description: Total infrastructure cost per patient per month. Sum of storage, compute, database, and backup costs.

DFDA_TARGET_COST_PER_PATIENT_USD.description: Target cost per patient in USD (same as DFDA_TARGET_COST_PER_PATIENT but in dollars)

DFDA_TOTAL_EXPLORATION_YEARS.description: Years to test all therapeutic combinations (known safe + emerging modalities) with dFDA capacity

DFDA_TRIALS_PER_YEAR_CAPACITY.description: Maximum trials per year possible with trial capacity multiplier

DFDA_TRIAL_CAPACITY_DALYS_AVERTED.description: Total DALYs averted from trial capacity increase alone. Calculated as annual global DALY burden × eventually avoidable percentage × treatment acceleration years. Includes both fatal and non-fatal diseases.

DFDA_TRIAL_CAPACITY_ECONOMIC_VALUE.description: Total economic value from trial capacity increase alone. DALYs valued at standard economic rate.

DFDA_TRIAL_CAPACITY_LIVES_SAVED.description: Total eventually avoidable deaths from trial capacity increase alone. Represents first treatments arriving earlier due to faster therapeutic space exploration from increased trial capacity.

DFDA_TRIAL_CAPACITY_MULTIPLIER.description: Trial capacity multiplier from dFDA funding capacity vs. current global trial participation

DFDA_TRIAL_CAPACITY_PLUS_EFFICACY_LAG_DA.description: Total DALYs averted from the combined dFDA timeline shift. Calculated as annual global DALY burden × eventually avoidable percentage × timeline shift years. Includes both fatal and non-fatal diseases (WHO GBD methodology).

DFDA_TRIAL_CAPACITY_PLUS_EFFICACY_LAG_EC.description: Total economic value from the combined dFDA timeline shift. DALYs valued at standard economic rate.

DFDA_TRIAL_CAPACITY_PLUS_EFFICACY_LAG_LI.description: Total eventually avoidable deaths from the combined dFDA timeline shift. Represents deaths prevented when cures arrive earlier due to both increased trial capacity and eliminated efficacy lag.

DFDA_TRIAL_CAPACITY_PLUS_EFFICACY_LAG_SU.description: Hours of suffering eliminated from the combined dFDA timeline shift. Calculated from YLD component of DALYs (39% of total DALYs × hours per year). One-time benefit, not annual recurring.

DFDA_TRIAL_CAPACITY_PLUS_EFFICACY_LAG_YE.description: Average years earlier patients receive treatments due to dFDA. Combines treatment timeline acceleration from increased trial capacity with efficacy lag elimination for treatments already discovered.

DFDA_TRIAL_CAPACITY_TREATMENT_ACCELERATI.description: Years earlier the average first treatment arrives due to dFDA's trial capacity increase. Calculated as the status quo timeline reduced by the inverse of the capacity multiplier. Uses only trial capacity multiplier (not combined with valley of death rescue) because additional candidates don't directly speed therapeutic space exploration.

DFDA_TRIAL_COST_REDUCTION_FACTOR.description: Cost reduction factor projected for dFDA pragmatic trials (traditional Phase 3 cost / dFDA pragmatic cost per patient)

DFDA_TRIAL_COST_REDUCTION_PCT.description: Trial cost reduction percentage: 1 - (dFDA pragmatic cost / traditional Phase 3 cost)

DFDA_TRIAL_SUBSIDIES_ANNUAL.description: Annual clinical trial patient subsidies from dFDA funding (total funding minus operational costs)

DFDA_UPFRONT_BUILD.description: Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment one-time build cost (central estimate)

DFDA_UPFRONT_BUILD_MAX.description: Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment one-time build cost (high estimate)

DFDA_VALLEY_OF_DEATH_RESCUE_MULTIPLIER.description: Factor increase in drugs entering development when dFDA eliminates Phase 2/3 cost barrier. Valley-of-death attrition (40%) becomes new drugs, so 1 + 0.40 = 1.4× more drugs.

DIH_NPV_ANNUAL_OPEX_INITIATIVES.description: DIH broader initiatives annual opex (medium case)

DIH_NPV_UPFRONT_COST_INITIATIVES.description: DIH broader initiatives upfront cost (medium case)

DIH_PATIENTS_FUNDABLE_ANNUALLY.description: Number of patients fundable annually at dFDA pragmatic trial cost. Based on empirical pragmatic trial costs (RECOVERY to PCORnet range).

DIH_TREASURY_MEDICAL_RESEARCH_PCT.description: Percentage of treaty funding allocated to medical research (after bond payouts and IAB incentives)

DIH_TREASURY_TO_MEDICAL_RESEARCH_ANNUAL.description: Annual funding for pragmatic clinical trials (treaty funding minus VICTORY Incentive Alignment Bond payouts and IAB political incentive mechanism)

DIH_TREASURY_TRIAL_SUBSIDIES_ANNUAL.description: Annual clinical trial patient subsidies (all medical research funds after Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment operations)

DIH_TREASURY_TRIAL_SUBSIDIES_PCT.description: Percentage of treaty funding going directly to patient trial subsidies

DISEASES_WITHOUT_EFFECTIVE_TREATMENT.description: Number of diseases without effective treatment. 95% of 7,000 rare diseases lack FDA-approved treatment (per Orphanet 2024). This represents the therapeutic search space that remains unexplored.

DISEASE_BURDEN_GDP_DRAG_PCT.description: Fraction of GDP currently lost to disease (productivity losses + medical costs diverted from productive use). $5T productivity loss + $9.9T direct medical costs = $14.9T on $115T GDP = ~13%. As diseases are progressively cured, this drag is recovered as GDP growth. This is the missing factor that makes the treaty trajectory look like a singularity rather than a modest improvement.

DISEASE_RELATED_CAREGIVER_PCT.description: Percentage of caregiving for treatable disease conditions (vs aging, disability, children)

DISEASE_VS_TERRORISM_DEATHS_RATIO.description: Ratio of annual disease deaths to 9/11 terrorism deaths

DISEASE_VS_WAR_DEATHS_RATIO.description: Ratio of annual disease deaths to war deaths

DIVIDEND_COVERAGE_FACTOR.description: Coverage factor of treaty funding vs Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment opex (sustainability margin)

DOT_VALUE_OF_STATISTICAL_LIFE.description: DOT Value of Statistical Life (2024). Used by federal agencies to evaluate safety regulations and quantify the economic value of mortality risk reductions.

DRUGS_APPROVED_SINCE_1962.description: Estimated total drugs approved globally since 1962 (62 years × average approval rate). Conservative: uses current rate, actual historical rate was lower in 1960s-80s.

DRUG_COST_INCREASE_1980S_TO_CURRENT_MULT.description: Drug development cost increase from 1980s to current

DRUG_COST_INCREASE_PRE1962_TO_CURRENT_MU.description: Drug development cost increase from pre-1962 to current

DRUG_DEVELOPMENT_COST_1980S.description: Drug development cost in 1980s (compounded to approval, 1990 dollars)

DRUG_DISCOVERY_TO_APPROVAL_YEARS.description: Full drug development timeline from discovery to FDA approval. Typical range is 12-15 years based on BIO 2021 and PMC meta-analyses. Breakdown: preclinical 4-6 years + clinical 10.5 years. Using 14 years as central estimate.

DRUG_DISEASE_COMBINATIONS_POSSIBLE.description: Total possible drug-disease combinations using existing safe compounds

DRUG_REPURPOSING_SUCCESS_RATE.description: Percentage of drugs that gain at least one new indication after initial approval

ECONOMIC_MULTIPLIER_EDUCATION_INVESTMENT.description: Economic multiplier for education investment (2.1x ROI)

ECONOMIC_MULTIPLIER_HEALTHCARE_INVESTMEN.description: Economic multiplier for healthcare investment (4.3x ROI). Literature range 3.0-6.0×.

ECONOMIC_MULTIPLIER_INFRASTRUCTURE_INVES.description: Economic multiplier for infrastructure investment (1.6x ROI)

ECONOMIC_MULTIPLIER_MILITARY_SPENDING.description: Economic multiplier for military spending (0.6x ROI). Literature range 0.4-1.0×.

EFFICACY_LAG_CUMULATIVE_EXCESS_COST.description: Cumulative Phase 2/3 efficacy testing cost since 1962. Uses direct Phase 2/3 cost per drug - this is a LOWER BOUND because it excludes opportunity cost of delays, compounds abandoned due to cost barrier, and regulatory overhead.

EFFICACY_LAG_DEATHS_911_EQUIVALENTS.description: Total deaths from efficacy lag expressed in 9/11 equivalents. Makes the mortality cost viscerally understandable: how many September 11ths worth of deaths did the 1962 efficacy requirements cause?

EFFICACY_LAG_TREATMENT_DELAY_YLD_ANNUAL.description: Annual YLD from treatment delay: patients receiving chronic disease treatment would have collectively avoided this disability if treatments were available 8.2 years earlier. Represents morbidity burden for treatment beneficiaries (distinct from mortality burden).

EFFICACY_LAG_YEARS.description: Regulatory delay for efficacy testing (Phase II/III) post-safety verification. Based on BIO 2021 industry survey. Note: This is for drugs that COMPLETE the pipeline - survivor bias means actual delay for any given disease may be longer if candidates fail and must restart.

EMERGING_MODALITY_COMBINATIONS.description: Total emerging modality combinations (gene therapy + mRNA + epigenetics + cell therapy)

EPIGENETIC_TARGETS_COUNT.description: Druggable epigenetic targets (HDACs, DNMTs, histone modifiers, bromodomains)

EVENTUALLY_AVOIDABLE_DALY_PCT.description: Percentage of DALYs that are eventually avoidable with sufficient biomedical research. Uses same methodology as EVENTUALLY_AVOIDABLE_DEATH_PCT. Most non-fatal chronic conditions (arthritis, depression, chronic pain) are also addressable through research, so the percentage is similar to deaths.

EVENTUALLY_AVOIDABLE_DEATH_PCT.description: Percentage of deaths that are eventually avoidable with sufficient biomedical research and technological advancement. Central estimate ~92% based on ~7.9% fundamentally unavoidable (primarily accidents). Wide uncertainty reflects debate over: (1) aging as addressable vs. fundamental, (2) asymptotic difficulty of last diseases, (3) multifactorial disease complexity.

EXISTING_DRUGS_EFFICACY_LAG_DEATHS_TOTAL.description: Total deaths from delaying existing drugs over 8.2-year efficacy lag. One-time impact of eliminating Phase 2-4 testing delay for drugs already approved 1962-2024. Based on Lichtenberg (2019) estimate of 12M lives saved annually × 8.2 years efficacy lag. Excludes innovation acceleration effects.

EXISTING_DRUGS_EFFICACY_LAG_ECONOMIC_LOS.description: Total economic loss from delaying existing drugs over 8.2-year efficacy lag. One-time benefit of eliminating Phase 2-4 delay. Excludes innovation acceleration effects.

EXPERT_DECISION_ACCURACY.description: Expert accuracy on Who Wants to Be a Millionaire phone-a-friend lifeline. Credentialed expert picked the correct answer 65% of the time (Surowiecki 2004). Used as baseline for conventional fund manager / committee allocation.

EXPLORATION_RATIO.description: Fraction of possible drug-disease space actually tested (<1%)

FDA_APPROVED_PRODUCTS_COUNT.description: Total FDA-approved drug products in the U.S.

FDA_APPROVED_UNIQUE_ACTIVE_INGREDIENTS.description: Unique active pharmaceutical ingredients in FDA-approved products (midpoint of 1,300-2,000 range)

FDA_GRAS_SUBSTANCES_COUNT.description: FDA Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) substances (midpoint of 570-700 range)

FDA_PHASE_1_TO_APPROVAL_YEARS.description: FDA timeline from Phase 1 start to approval. Derived from BIO 2021 industry survey: Phase 1 (2.3 years) + efficacy lag (8.2 years) = 10.5 years. Consistent with PMC meta-analysis finding 9.1 years median (95% CI: 8.2-10.0).

FDA_TO_OXFORD_RECOVERY_TRIAL_TIME_MULTIP.description: Efficacy testing time vs Oxford RECOVERY trial (8.2 years ÷ 3 months = 32.8x slower). Compares efficacy lag only (post-safety Phase II/III) since RECOVERY was an efficacy trial.

FUNDAMENTALLY_UNAVOIDABLE_DEATH_PCT.description: Percentage of deaths that are fundamentally unavoidable even with perfect biotechnology (primarily accidents). Calculated as Σ(disease_burden × (1 - max_cure_potential)) across all disease categories.

GDP_BASELINE_GROWTH_RATE.description: Status-quo baseline annual global GDP growth rate.

GENE_THERAPY_DISEASE_COMBINATIONS.description: Gene therapy target-disease combinations (CRISPR, base editing, viral vectors)

GIVEWELL_COST_PER_LIFE_AVG.description: GiveWell average cost per life saved across top charities

GIVEWELL_COST_PER_LIFE_MAX.description: GiveWell cost per life saved (Against Malaria Foundation)

GIVEWELL_COST_PER_LIFE_MIN.description: GiveWell cost per life saved (Helen Keller International)

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_CONFLICT_DEATHS_ACTIVE_COM.description: Annual deaths from active combat worldwide

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_CONFLICT_DEATHS_TERROR_ATT.description: Annual deaths from terror attacks globally

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_CONFLICT_DEATHS_TOTAL.description: Total annual conflict deaths globally (sum of combat, terror, state violence)

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_DALY_BURDEN.description: Global annual DALY burden from all diseases and injuries (WHO/IHME Global Burden of Disease 2021). Includes both YLL (years of life lost) and YLD (years lived with disability) from all causes.

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_DEATHS_CURABLE_DISEASES.description: Annual deaths from all diseases and aging globally

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_DIRECT_INDIRECT_WAR_COST.description: Total annual cost of war worldwide (direct + indirect costs)

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_ENVIRONMENTAL_DAMAGE_CONFL.description: Annual environmental damage and restoration costs from conflict

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_HUMAN_COST_ACTIVE_COMBAT.description: Annual cost of combat deaths (deaths × VSL)

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_HUMAN_COST_STATE_VIOLENCE.description: Annual cost of state violence deaths (deaths × VSL)

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_HUMAN_COST_TERROR_ATTACKS.description: Annual cost of terror deaths (deaths × VSL)

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_HUMAN_LIFE_LOSSES_CONFLICT.description: Total annual human life losses from conflict (sum of combat, terror, state violence)

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_INFRASTRUCTURE_DAMAGE_COMM.description: Annual infrastructure damage to communications from conflict

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_INFRASTRUCTURE_DAMAGE_EDUC.description: Annual infrastructure damage to education facilities from conflict

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_INFRASTRUCTURE_DAMAGE_ENER.description: Annual infrastructure damage to energy systems from conflict

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_INFRASTRUCTURE_DAMAGE_HEAL.description: Annual infrastructure damage to healthcare facilities from conflict

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_INFRASTRUCTURE_DAMAGE_TRAN.description: Annual infrastructure damage to transportation from conflict

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_INFRASTRUCTURE_DAMAGE_WATE.description: Annual infrastructure damage to water systems from conflict

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_INFRASTRUCTURE_DESTRUCTION.description: Total annual infrastructure destruction (sum of transportation, energy, communications, water, education, healthcare)
GLOBAL_ANNUAL_INFRASTRUCTURE_DESTRUCTION.formula: TRANSPORT + ENERGY + COMMS + WATER + EDUCATION + HEALTHCARE

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_LIVES_SAVED_BY_MED_RESEARC.description: Annual lives saved by medical research globally

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_LOST_ECONOMIC_GROWTH_MILIT.description: Annual foregone economic output from military spending vs productive alternatives. This estimate implicitly captures fiscal multiplier differences (military ~0.6x vs healthcare ~4.3x GDP multiplier). Do not add separate GDP multiplier adjustment to avoid double-counting.

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_LOST_HUMAN_CAPITAL_CONFLIC.description: Annual lost productivity from conflict casualties

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_PSYCHOLOGICAL_IMPACT_COSTS.description: Annual PTSD and mental health costs from conflict

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_SAVINGS.description: Global annual savings in USD (savings rate × GDP)

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_SAVINGS_PER_CAPITA.description: Global annual savings divided by global population. Useful as a rough average-person default for prize-contribution sizing.

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_TRADE_DISRUPTION_CONFLICT.description: Total annual trade disruption (sum of shipping, supply chain, energy prices, currency instability)

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_TRADE_DISRUPTION_CURRENCY_.description: Annual trade disruption costs from currency instability

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_TRADE_DISRUPTION_ENERGY_PR.description: Annual trade disruption costs from energy price volatility

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_TRADE_DISRUPTION_SHIPPING_.description: Annual trade disruption costs from shipping disruptions

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_TRADE_DISRUPTION_SUPPLY_CH.description: Annual trade disruption costs from supply chain disruptions

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_WAR_DIRECT_COSTS_TOTAL.description: Total annual direct war costs (military spending + infrastructure + human life + trade disruption)

GLOBAL_ANNUAL_WAR_INDIRECT_COSTS_TOTAL.description: Total annual indirect war costs (opportunity cost + veterans + refugees + environment + mental health + lost productivity)
GLOBAL_ANNUAL_WAR_INDIRECT_COSTS_TOTAL.formula: OPPORTUNITY + VETERANS + REFUGEES + ENVIRONMENT + MENTAL_HEALTH + LOST_CAPITAL

GLOBAL_AVG_HOURLY_INCOME.description: Global average hourly income derived from GDP per capita. Uses average (not median), which overestimates the cost of sharing, making the payoff ratio conservative.

GLOBAL_AVG_INCOME_2025.description: Global average income (GDP per capita) in 2025 baseline.

GLOBAL_AVG_REMAINING_YEARS.description: Average remaining lifespan for the median-age person. Conservative: uses life expectancy at birth minus median age, which underestimates remaining years because survivors to age 30 have higher conditional life expectancy.

GLOBAL_BULLETS_PURCHASABLE_ANNUAL.description: Number of 5.56mm NATO rounds purchasable with the entire global military budget at bulk procurement prices. Pure purchasing power calculation, not a combat efficiency estimate.

GLOBAL_CHRONIC_THERAPY_DAYS_ANNUAL.description: Annual days of therapy for chronic conditions globally (diabetes, CVD, respiratory, cancer). IQVIA reports 1.8 trillion total days of therapy in 2019, with 71% for chronic conditions.

GLOBAL_CLINICAL_TRIALS_SPENDING_ANNUAL.description: Annual global spending on clinical trials (Industry: $45-60B + Government: $3-6B + Nonprofits: $2-5B). Conservative estimate using 15-20% of $300B total pharma R&D, not inflated market size projections.

GLOBAL_COORDINATION_ACTIVATION_BUDGET.description: Canonical institutional activation threshold: capital required to make 50% participation credible through direct referral incentives, verification, payment rails, and global launch operations. This is the main institutional ask, not the PRIZE pool seed benchmark.

GLOBAL_COORDINATION_ACTIVATION_COST_PER_.description: Blended variable activation cost per successful verified participant: direct incentive plus verification and payment operations.

GLOBAL_COORDINATION_ACTIVATION_REWARD_PE.description: Planning midpoint for the direct cash incentive required to make a successful verified recruit materially worth sharing at global scale. Intended as a research-backed blended reward across referrer and recruit, not as the long-dated PRIZE claim value.

GLOBAL_COORDINATION_PLATFORM_AND_OPERATI.description: Fixed cost to run a global activation campaign toward 50% participation: platform buildout, localization, customer support, compliance, payout operations, fraud response, and regional launch infrastructure.

GLOBAL_COORDINATION_TARGET_PCT.description: Modeled end-state global coordination target: half of humanity visibly supports the prize network, used in prose as roughly 90% of likely voters globally.

GLOBAL_COORDINATION_TARGET_SUPPORTERS.description: Number of people implied by the modeled end-state global coordination target (global population × 50%).

GLOBAL_COORDINATION_VERIFICATION_AND_PAY.description: Planning midpoint for non-reward variable cost per successful verified participant: identity verification, payment rails, fraud checks, support, and completion friction.

GLOBAL_COST_PER_LIFE_SAVED_MED_RESEARCH_.description: Cost per life saved by medical research

GLOBAL_CYBERCRIME_CAGR.description: Compound annual growth rate of global cybercrime costs. Cybersecurity Ventures: $3T (2015) -> $6T (2021) -> $10.5T (2025). AI-enhanced attacks are accelerating this trend.

GLOBAL_CYBERCRIME_COST_ANNUAL_2025.description: Projected global cybercrime costs in 2025. Includes data theft, productivity loss, IP theft, fraud. More profitable than global trade of all major illegal drugs combined. If measured as a country, would be the 3rd largest economy after US and China.

GLOBAL_DESTRUCTIVE_ECONOMY_ANNUAL_2025.description: Combined annual cost of military spending and cybercrime. The 'destructive economy' that competes with the productive economy.

GLOBAL_DESTRUCTIVE_ECONOMY_PCT_GDP.description: Destructive economy (military + cybercrime) as percentage of global GDP.

GLOBAL_DISEASE_DEATHS_DAILY.description: Total global deaths per day from all disease and aging (WHO Global Burden of Disease 2024)

GLOBAL_DISEASE_DEATHS_PER_MINUTE.description: Global deaths per minute from all disease and aging

GLOBAL_DISEASE_DIRECT_MEDICAL_COST_ANNUA.description: Direct medical costs of disease globally (treatment, hospitalization, medication). Standalone market-cost metric; not included in DALY-based welfare burden to avoid double-counting.

GLOBAL_DISEASE_ECONOMIC_BURDEN_ANNUAL.description: Annual welfare cost of avoidable disease globally. Calculated as global DALY burden × eventually avoidable percentage × standard QALY value ($150K). Uses consistent QALY valuation matching all other health impact calculations. Medical costs and productivity losses are NOT added separately to avoid double-counting (QALY valuation already captures these welfare components).

GLOBAL_DISEASE_PRODUCTIVITY_LOSS_ANNUAL.description: Annual productivity loss from disease globally (absenteeism, reduced output). Standalone market-cost metric; not included in DALY-based welfare burden to avoid double-counting.

GLOBAL_GDP_2025.description: Global nominal GDP (2025 estimate). From Political Dysfunction Tax paper citing StatisticsTimes/IMF World Economic Outlook. Used for calculating global opportunity costs as percentage of world economic output. Note: Latest IMF data shows $117T.

GLOBAL_GDP_PER_CAPITA_1900.description: Global GDP per capita in 1900 in constant 2024 USD. Maddison Project: ~$1,260 in 1990 international dollars, adjusted to 2024 USD (~2.5x).

GLOBAL_GOVERNMENT_CLINICAL_TRIALS_SPENDI.description: Annual global government spending on interventional clinical trials (~5-10% of total)

GLOBAL_HALE_CURRENT.description: Global healthy life expectancy at birth (HALE) from WHO Global Health Observatory, 2019 data (most recent available). HALE measures years lived in full health, adjusting for years lived with disability or disease.

GLOBAL_HALE_GAP.description: Gap between life expectancy and healthy life expectancy. Represents years lived with disability or disease that could be recovered by curing diseases.

GLOBAL_INDUSTRY_CLINICAL_TRIALS_SPENDING.description: Annual global industry spending on clinical trials (Total - Government)

GLOBAL_INVESTABLE_ASSETS.description: Total global financial wealth (2024): equities, bonds, cash/deposits, and investment funds. Excludes real estate and physical assets. This is the addressable capital pool for PRIZE deposits.

GLOBAL_MEDIAN_AGE_2024.description: Global median age in 2024 from UN World Population Prospects 2024 revision.

GLOBAL_MILITARY_SPENDING_ANNUAL_2005.description: Global military spending in 2005, constant 2023 USD (SIPRI World total). Used as the 20-year reference point for computing the long-horizon real CAGR.

GLOBAL_MILITARY_SPENDING_POST_TREATY_ANN.description: Global military spending after 1% treaty reduction

GLOBAL_MILITARY_SPENDING_REAL_CAGR_10YR.description: Real compound annual growth rate of global military spending over the last decade (2014-2024). SIPRI reports 10 consecutive annual increases, with 2024 up 9.4% in real terms. The 10-year CAGR is approximately 3.4% real.

GLOBAL_MILITARY_SPENDING_REAL_CAGR_20YR.description: Real compound annual growth rate of global military spending over the last 20 years (2005-2024), computed from SIPRI World totals in constant 2023 USD. This window deliberately includes the 2011-2014 drawdown, so it cannot be attacked as trough-to-peak cherry picking. The 20-year rate (~2.75%) is actually lower than the 10-year rate (3.4%) precisely because the drawdown pulls the average down.

GLOBAL_NONPROFIT_CLINICAL_TRIALS_SPENDIN.description: Annual global nonprofit spending on clinical trials (foundations, disease advocacy groups)

GLOBAL_NUCLEAR_WEAPONS_SPENDING.description: Annual global spending on nuclear weapons across all nine nuclear-armed states. US: $51.5B, China: $11.8B, UK: $8.1B, Russia: $8.3B, France: $6.8B, India: ~$2.7B, Israel: ~$1.2B, Pakistan: ~$1.1B, North Korea: ~$0.7B.

GLOBAL_PHARMA_RD_SPENDING_ANNUAL.description: Total global pharmaceutical R&D spending ($300B annually, clinical trials represent 15-20% of this total)

GLOBAL_POLITICAL_REFORM_INVESTMENT.description: Estimated global advocacy investment for policy reform. Calculated as US costs × global ratio (based on discretionary spending). Upper bound representing full democratic engagement at scale.

GLOBAL_POPULATION_2040_PROJECTED.description: UN World Population Prospects 2022 median projection for 2040. Interpolated midpoint between ~8.1B (2025) and 9.2B (2045).

GLOBAL_POPULATION_2045_PROJECTED.description: UN World Population Prospects 2022 median projection for 2045.

GLOBAL_POPULATION_ACTIVISM_THRESHOLD_PCT.description: Critical mass threshold for social change (3.5% rule). Chenoweth studied national regime changes; applying to a global treaty adds uncertainty. Lower bound: some movements succeeded at ~1%. Upper bound: entrenched defense-industry opposition and weaker signal from digital signatures vs sustained protest may require up to 10%.

GLOBAL_RETIREMENT_ASSETS.description: Total global pension and retirement assets (OECD 2024). This is the capital pool that the Prize Fund competes with and could partially absorb.

GLOBAL_SAVINGS_RATE_PCT.description: Global gross savings as share of GDP (World Bank, ~27% average 2023-2024)

GLOBAL_SYMPTOMATIC_DISEASE_TREATMENT_ANN.description: Annual global spending on symptomatic disease treatment

GLOBAL_TOTAL_HEALTH_AND_WAR_COST_ANNUAL.description: Total annual welfare cost of war and disease. Disease burden uses DALY-based welfare valuation; war costs use direct + indirect economic costs. Symptomatic treatment costs NOT added separately (already captured in QALY valuation).

GLOBAL_TO_US_POLITICAL_COST_RATIO.description: Ratio of global to US political reform costs. Based on discretionary spending ratio (~9x) discounted by ~50% for less transparent/expensive non-US political systems. Range 3-8 reflects uncertainty about non-US political dynamics and hidden influence channels.

GLOBAL_WARHEAD_COUNT.description: Total global nuclear warhead inventory across nine nuclear-armed states. Includes deployed, reserve, and retired warheads awaiting dismantlement.

GLOBAL_WAR_COST_LIFETIME_CUMULATIVE_BASE.description: Cumulative global war cost over 80 years (one human lifespan) on the baseline trajectory, where war costs keep compounding at SIPRI's 20-year real CAGR (2.76%). This is what the world pays if nothing changes.

GLOBAL_WAR_COST_LIFETIME_CUMULATIVE_TREA.description: Cumulative global war cost over 80 years under the treaty trajectory, where costs drop 1% immediately and then hold flat (no growth). This is what the world pays after the treaty passes.

GLOBAL_WAR_COST_LIFETIME_PER_PERSON_ABOL.description: Per-person future value at year 80 of the full baseline war cost stream, compounded at the illustrative long-term real return rate (13%, Nasdaq-100 historical). This is the hypothetical opportunity cost per person of running the baseline SIPRI trajectory rather than abolishing war entirely and redirecting every dollar. Serves as the ceiling on the peace dividend ladder: the treaty gets you a large fraction of this number, full abolition gets you all of it.

GLOBAL_WAR_COST_LIFETIME_PER_PERSON_BASE.description: Per-person 80-year lifetime tab for global war costs on the SIPRI baseline trajectory (2.76% real growth). About 3.5x the flat-assumption figure the chapter opens with, because war costs have been compounding while nobody updated the invoice.

GLOBAL_WAR_COST_LIFETIME_PER_PERSON_FLAT.description: Per-person 80-year lifetime tab for global war costs, assuming costs stay flat at today's level. This is the conservative floor the chapter opens with. The actual figure is higher because war costs have been compounding in real terms.

GLOBAL_WAR_COST_YEARS_UNTIL_EXCEEDS_GDP.description: Years until annual war cost exceeds current world GDP at the SIPRI 20-year real growth rate. At ~2.76% real growth and $11.4T current war cost, this happens in under a century. The baseline trajectory is therefore a countdown, not a plan.

GLOBAL_WAR_COST_YEAR_80_BASELINE.description: Projected annual war cost in year 80 under the baseline trajectory, assuming the SIPRI 20-year real CAGR continues. At ~2.76% real growth, this approaches current world GDP (which is why the baseline trajectory breaks math around year 85).

GLOBAL_YLD_PROPORTION_OF_DALYS.description: Proportion of global DALYs that are YLD (years lived with disability) vs YLL (years of life lost). From GBD 2021: 1.13B YLD out of 2.88B total DALYs = 39%.

HALE_LONGEVITY_REALIZATION_SHARE_YEAR_15.description: Share of longer-run life-extension gains that have plausibly materialized into healthy years by year 15. Calibrated to the repo's conservative disease-eradication helper, which implies that only a minority of eventual longevity gains are realized within the first 15 years even under rapid research acceleration.

HEALTHCARE_VS_MILITARY_MULTIPLIER_RATIO.description: Ratio of healthcare to military fiscal multipliers. Healthcare investment generates 7× more economic activity per dollar than military spending.

HOME_BIAS_ALPHA.description: Return drag from home bias in fragmented national pension systems. 70+ countries each overweight domestic assets, missing global diversification. IMF and Vanguard studies estimate 0.3-1.5% annual return cost. Wishocratic allocation is inherently global, eliminating this drag.

HUMAN_GENOME_PROJECT_TOTAL_ECONOMIC_IMPA.description: Estimated total economic impact of Human Genome Project

HUMAN_INTERACTOME_TARGETED_PCT.description: Percentage of human interactome (protein-protein interactions) targeted by drugs

HUMAN_PROTEIN_CODING_GENES.description: Human protein-coding genes targetable by gene therapy, mRNA, or biologics (Human Genome Project consensus)

IAB_MECHANISM_ANNUAL_COST.description: Estimated annual cost of the IAB mechanism (high-end estimate including regulatory defense)

IAB_MECHANISM_BENEFIT_COST_RATIO.description: Benefit-Cost Ratio of the IAB mechanism itself

IAB_POLITICAL_INCENTIVE_FUNDING_ANNUAL.description: Annual funding for IAB political incentive mechanism (independent expenditures supporting high-scoring politicians, post-office fellowship endowments, Public Good Score infrastructure)

IAB_POLITICAL_INCENTIVE_FUNDING_PCT.description: Percentage of treaty funding allocated to Incentive Alignment Bond mechanism for political incentives (independent expenditures/PACs, post-office fellowships, Public Good Score infrastructure)

IAB_VS_DEFENSE_LOBBY_RATIO_AT_1PCT.description: Ratio of IAB political incentive funding to defense industry lobbying at 1% treaty level. At just 1%, the health lobby already outguns the defense lobby by this factor.

ICD_10_TOTAL_CODES.description: Total ICD-10 diagnostic codes for human diseases and conditions

INDUSTRY_VS_GOVERNMENT_CLINICAL_TRIALS_S.description: Ratio of Industry to Government spending on clinical trials (approx 90/10 split)

LIFE_EXPECTANCY_GAIN_1883_1962_YEARS_PER.description: US life expectancy linear gain rate 1883-1962 (pre-Kefauver-Harris).

LIFE_EXPECTANCY_GAIN_1962_2019_YEARS_PER.description: US life expectancy linear gain rate 1962-2019 (post-Kefauver-Harris).

LIFE_EXTENSION_YEARS.description: Expected years of life extension from 1% treaty research acceleration (25x trial capacity). Bounds: 0 (complete failure) to ~150 (accident-limited lifespan minus current). Lognormal distribution allows for breakthrough scenarios.

LOBBYIST_BOND_INVESTMENT_MAX.description: Maximum bond investment for lobbyist incentives

MEASLES_VACCINATION_ROI.description: Return on investment from measles (MMR) vaccination programs

MEDICAL_QALY_THRESHOLD.description: Medical cost-effectiveness QALY threshold. Standard threshold for evaluating whether health interventions are cost-effective. Interventions below $100K/QALY are generally considered cost-effective.

MEDICAL_RESEARCH_PCT_OF_DISEASE_BURDEN.description: Medical research spending as percentage of total disease burden

MENTAL_HEALTH_PRODUCTIVITY_LOSS_PER_CAPI.description: Annual productivity loss per capita from mental health issues (beyond treatment costs)

MILITARY_REDIRECT_GDP_BOOST_AT_30PCT.description: Historical calibration target: 30% military reallocation maps to ~5.5 percentage points annual GDP growth boost.

MILITARY_TO_CLINICAL_TRIALS_SPENDING_RAT.description: Ratio of global military spending to all clinical trials spending (government + industry + nonprofit)

MILITARY_TO_GOVERNMENT_CLINICAL_TRIALS_S.description: Ratio of global military spending to government clinical trials spending

MILITARY_VS_MEDICAL_RESEARCH_RATIO.description: Ratio of military spending to medical research spending

MISALLOCATION_FACTOR_DEATH_VS_SAVING.description: Misallocation factor: cost to kill vs cost to save

MONEY_PRINTER_WAR_DEATHS.description: Cumulative deaths from 6 wars funded by money printing: Napoleonic (5M), Civil War (750K), WWI (20M), WWII (60M), Korea (3M), Vietnam (3M), post-9/11 (4.5M). Mid-range estimates; conservative total exceeds 110M.

MRNA_THERAPEUTIC_COMBINATIONS.description: mRNA therapeutic combinations (protein replacement, vaccines, enzyme delivery)

NATO_DEFENSE_SPENDING_ANNUAL.description: Total NATO member defense spending in 2024. Source: SIPRI.

NEW_DISEASE_FIRST_TREATMENTS_PER_YEAR.description: Number of diseases that receive their FIRST effective treatment each year under current system. ~9 rare diseases/year (based on 40 years of ODA: 350 with treatment ÷ 40 years), plus ~5-10 common diseases. Note: FDA approves ~50 drugs/year, but most are for diseases that already have treatments.

NIH_CLINICAL_TRIALS_SPENDING_PCT.description: Percentage of NIH budget spent on clinical trials (3.3%)

NIH_STANDARD_RESEARCH_COST_PER_QALY.description: Typical cost per QALY for standard NIH-funded medical research portfolio. Reflects the inefficiency of traditional RCTs and basic research-heavy allocation. See confidence_interval for range; ICER uses higher thresholds for value-based pricing.

NIH_TRADITIONAL_TRIAL_MAX_EFFICIENCY_PCT.description: Maximum efficiency of NIH traditional Phase 3 trials relative to pragmatic trials, expressed as a percentage. Calculated as pragmatic cost / traditional cost. This is a CEILING on NIH trial efficiency because: (1) only 3.3% of NIH budget goes to clinical trials at all, and (2) the other 96.7% funds basic research with far lower marginal value when thousands of safe compounds already await testing.

NPV_DISCOUNT_RATE_STANDARD.description: Standard discount rate for NPV analysis (3% annual, social discount rate)

NPV_TIME_HORIZON_YEARS.description: Standard time horizon for NPV analysis

NUCLEAR_OVERKILL_FACTOR.description: How many times the global nuclear arsenal can kill Earth's entire population. Based on total potential deaths from existing arsenals (~158.4B) divided by global population (~8B). See nuclear-weapon-cost-and-casualties appendix.

NUCLEAR_WINTER_OVERKILL_FACTOR.description: How many times the global nuclear arsenal exceeds the threshold for nuclear winter (~4,400 warheads for 150 Tg soot). The arsenal-based overkill factor for the actual extinction mechanism.

NUCLEAR_WINTER_WARHEAD_THRESHOLD.description: Approximate number of warheads needed to trigger nuclear winter (150 Tg soot), killing ~5 billion people from agricultural collapse. Based on Xia et al. 2022, Nature Food, modeling a US-Russia exchange.

OXFORD_RECOVERY_TRIAL_DURATION_MONTHS.description: Oxford RECOVERY trial duration (found life-saving treatment in 3 months)

PATIENT_WILLINGNESS_TRIAL_PARTICIPATION_.description: Patient willingness to participate in drug trials (44.8% in surveys, 88% when actually approached)

PEACE_DIVIDEND_ANNUAL_SOCIETAL_BENEFIT.description: Annual peace dividend from 1% reduction in total war costs (theoretical maximum at ε=1.0)

PEACE_DIVIDEND_CONFLICT_ELASTICITY.description: Conflict reduction elasticity: how much conflict costs decrease per 1% military spending cut. ε=0: no effect (spending cuts don't reduce conflict). ε=0.5: moderate linkage (conservative). ε=1.0: proportional (baseline assumption). ε>1.0: shared enemy amplification (redirecting to disease creates unity).
PEACE_DIVIDEND_CONFLICT_ELASTICITY.formula: 1% spending cut → ε% conflict cost reduction

PEACE_DIVIDEND_CONFLICT_REDUCTION.description: Conflict reduction benefits from 1% less military spending (lower confidence - assumes proportional relationship)

PEACE_DIVIDEND_DIRECT_COSTS.description: Annual savings from 1% reduction in direct war costs

PEACE_DIVIDEND_DIRECT_FISCAL_SAVINGS.description: Direct fiscal savings from 1% military spending reduction (high confidence)

PEACE_DIVIDEND_ENVIRONMENTAL.description: Annual savings from 1% reduction in environmental damage

PEACE_DIVIDEND_HUMAN_CASUALTIES.description: Annual savings from 1% reduction in human casualties

PEACE_DIVIDEND_INDIRECT_COSTS.description: Annual savings from 1% reduction in indirect war costs

PEACE_DIVIDEND_INFRASTRUCTURE.description: Annual savings from 1% reduction in infrastructure destruction

PEACE_DIVIDEND_INVESTMENT_REAL_RETURN_RA.description: Illustrative long-term real return rate used to compound the peace dividend stream into a future value at year 80. 13% is the approximate long-run real CAGR of the Nasdaq-100 index since its 1985 inception: accessible via passive ETFs (QQQ), grounded in 40+ years of data, and does not require assuming unique skill (Buffett) or access (VC/private markets). Chosen as more optimistic than 60/40 portfolio (5%) or S&P 500 (7%) because growth-tilted founder-led companies have historically outperformed the broad market.

PEACE_DIVIDEND_LIFETIME_PCT_OF_BASELINE.description: Fraction of the baseline 80-year war cost avoided by the treaty. Because the baseline compounds exponentially while the treaty holds spending flat, cutting 1% today and halting the growth trajectory avoids about 72% of the cumulative 80-year war cost. Most of the savings come from the halted growth, not the headline 1% cut.

PEACE_DIVIDEND_LIFETIME_PER_PERSON.description: Per-person share of the 80-year cumulative peace dividend, averaged across the global population. Not literally a check in the reader's pocket: most of it arrives as infrastructure not destroyed, wages not taxed to rebuild things that should not have been destroyed, and conflicts that never happen. Per-capita division hides that the poorest bear far more than the average today.

PEACE_DIVIDEND_LIFETIME_PER_PERSON_COMPO.description: Per-person future value at year 80 of the treaty peace dividend stream, compounded at the illustrative long-term real return rate (13%, Nasdaq-100 historical). Each year's savings are invested at the end of that year and compound until year 80. This is an opportunity-cost framing, not a promise of cash in the reader's pocket: the 'return' is the real productive use of capital that weapons spending displaced, not a literal brokerage account.

PEACE_DIVIDEND_LIFETIME_TOTAL.description: Cumulative peace dividend over 80 years (one human lifespan): the baseline 80-year war cost (SIPRI trajectory) minus the treaty 80-year war cost (flat at 99% of today). Assumes elasticity of 1.0 between military spending and war costs, which is almost certainly conservative because the political act of passing the treaty itself would reflect and reinforce a 'war is stupid' consensus that reduces externalities super-proportionally.

PEACE_DIVIDEND_LOST_ECONOMIC_GROWTH.description: Annual savings from 1% reduction in lost economic growth

PEACE_DIVIDEND_LOST_HUMAN_CAPITAL.description: Annual savings from 1% reduction in lost human capital

PEACE_DIVIDEND_PTSD.description: Annual savings from 1% reduction in PTSD and mental health costs

PEACE_DIVIDEND_REFUGEE_SUPPORT.description: Annual savings from 1% reduction in refugee support costs

PEACE_DIVIDEND_TRADE_DISRUPTION.description: Annual savings from 1% reduction in trade disruption

PEACE_DIVIDEND_VETERAN_HEALTHCARE.description: Annual savings from 1% reduction in veteran healthcare costs

PEACE_DIVIDEND_YEARS_UNTIL_BASELINE_EXCE.description: Years until annual war cost exceeds current world GDP at the SIPRI 20-year real growth rate. At ~2.76% real growth and $11.4T current war cost, this happens in under a century. The baseline trajectory is therefore a countdown, not a plan.

PEACE_TRAJECTORY_TOTAL_DIFFERENTIAL_20YR.description: Total 20-year value of the peace trajectory: research funding redirected to medicine plus war externality costs avoided. The full differential between the IAB trajectory and the current trajectory. Does not include existential risk reduction.

PERSONAL_LIFETIME_WEALTH.description: Personal lifetime wealth from life extension valued at standard QALY rate. Simple formula: years of life gained × economic value per healthy year. Uncertainty in LIFE_EXTENSION_YEARS (5-100 year range, median 20) propagates through Monte Carlo.

PER_CAPITA_CHRONIC_DISEASE_COST.description: US per capita chronic disease cost

PER_CAPITA_MENTAL_HEALTH_COST.description: US per capita mental health cost

PHARMA_DRUG_DEVELOPMENT_COST_CURRENT.description: Average cost to develop one drug in current system

PHARMA_DRUG_REVENUE_AVERAGE_CURRENT.description: Median lifetime revenue per successful drug (study of 361 FDA-approved drugs 1995-2014, median follow-up 13.2 years)

PHARMA_LIFE_YEARS_SAVED_ANNUAL.description: Annual life-years saved by pharmaceutical innovations globally. Lichtenberg (2019, NBER WP 25483) found that drugs launched after 1981 saved 148.7M life-years in 2013 across 22 countries using 3-way fixed-effects regression (disease-country-year). 95% CI [79.4M, 239.8M] propagated from Table 2 regression standard errors (β₀₋₁₁=-0.031±0.008, β₁₂₊=-0.057±0.013).

PHARMA_LIVES_SAVED_ANNUAL.description: Annual lives saved by pharmaceutical interventions globally. Derived from Lichtenberg (2019) finding of 148.7M life-years saved, divided by assumed 12-year average life extension per beneficiary. Note: Life-years is the primary metric; lives is an approximation for intuitive communication.

PHARMA_PHASE_2_3_COST_BARRIER.description: Average Phase 2/3 efficacy testing cost per drug that pharma must fund (~60% of total drug development cost)

PHARMA_ROI_CURRENT_SYSTEM_PCT.description: ROI for pharma R&D (2022 historic low from Deloitte study of top 20 pharma companies, down from 6.8% in 2021, recovered to 5.9% in 2024)

PHARMA_SUCCESS_RATE_CURRENT_PCT.description: Percentage of drugs that reach market in current system

PHASE_1_PASSED_COMPOUNDS_GLOBAL.description: Investigational compounds that have passed Phase I globally (midpoint of 5,000-10,000 range)

PHASE_2_3_CLINICAL_TRIAL_COST_PCT.description: Percentage of total clinical trial spending on Phase 2/3 efficacy testing (Phase 2: 24% + Phase 3: 45%)

PMC_PRAGMATIC_TRIAL_MEDIAN_COST_PER_PATI.description: Median cost per patient in embedded pragmatic clinical trials (Ramsberg & Platt 2018: 108 trials reviewed, 64 with cost data). IQR: $19-$478 (2015 USD).

POLIO_VACCINATION_ROI.description: Return on investment from sustaining polio vaccination assets and integrating into expanded immunization programs

POLITICAL_DYSFUNCTION_GLOBAL_EFFICIENCY_.description: Global Governance Efficiency Score from Political Dysfunction Tax paper. E = Adjusted W_real / W_max, where W_real = GDP - waste, W_max = W_real + opportunity cost. Paper calculates 30-52% efficiency (using $110.9T adjusted / $211.9T maximum). This means civilization operates at roughly half its technological potential.

POLITICAL_DYSFUNCTION_GLOBAL_FOSSIL_FUEL.description: Global explicit fossil fuel subsidies (governments undercharging for energy supply costs). IMF 2022 estimate. These subsidies actively encourage consumption of negative-externality goods, working against climate goals. Note: IMF implicit subsidies (externalities) are much larger (~$7T).

POLITICAL_DYSFUNCTION_GLOBAL_HEALTH_OPPO.description: Annual opportunity cost of slow-motion regulatory environment for health innovation. Murphy-Topel (2006) valued cancer cure at $50T (inflation-adjusted ~$100T in 2025). Longevity dividend of 1 extra year = $38T globally. PCTs could accelerate cures by 10+ years; NPV of 10-year delay at 3% discount = ~$25T. Conservative estimate: $34T annually in lives lost and healthspan denied.

POLITICAL_DYSFUNCTION_GLOBAL_LEAD_OPPORT.description: Global cost of lead exposure: World Bank/Lancet estimate. 765 million IQ points lost annually, 5.5 million premature CVD deaths. Cost to eliminate lead from paint, spices, batteries is trivial compared to damage. This is an arbitrage opportunity of immense scale that governance has failed to execute.

POLITICAL_DYSFUNCTION_GLOBAL_MIGRATION_O.description: Unrealized output from migration restrictions. Clemens (2011) calculated eliminating labor mobility barriers could increase global GDP by 50-150%. At $115T global GDP, lower bound = $57T; upper bound = $170T. Even 5% workforce mobility would generate trillions, exceeding all foreign aid ever given. This is the largest single distortion in the global economy.

POLITICAL_DYSFUNCTION_GLOBAL_OPPORTUNITY.description: Global opportunity cost as percentage of global GDP. $101T / $115T = ~88% of current GDP in unrealized potential. This represents the 'buried multipliers' of the global economy.

Total global opportunity cost from governance failures: health innovation delays ($34T), underfunded science ($4T), lead poisoning ($6T), migration restrictions ($57T). Sum: $101T annually in unrealized potential.

POLITICAL_DYSFUNCTION_GLOBAL_REALIZED_WE.description: Adjusted realized welfare after subtracting measured governance waste from global GDP.

POLITICAL_DYSFUNCTION_GLOBAL_SCIENCE_OPP.description: Annual opportunity cost from underfunding high-ROI science (fusion, AI safety). Human Genome Project: $3.8B cost, $796B-1T impact (141:1 ROI). Fusion DEMO plant: $5-10B could solve energy/climate permanently. AI safety: <5% of capabilities spending despite existential stakes. Reallocating $200B from military waste at 20x multiplier = $4T foregone growth.

POLITICAL_DYSFUNCTION_GLOBAL_THEORETICAL.description: Conservative theoretical maximum welfare under opportunity-cost recapture assumptions.

POLITICAL_DYSFUNCTION_GLOBAL_WASTE_TOTAL.description: Global waste deduction used in Political Dysfunction Tax efficiency accounting. Combines US governance waste estimate with global explicit fossil-fuel subsidies.

POLITICAL_DYSFUNCTION_TAX_PER_HOUSEHOLD_.description: Annual household burden for a 4-person household implied by global Political Dysfunction Tax.

POLITICAL_DYSFUNCTION_TAX_PER_PERSON_ANN.description: Annual per-person burden implied by global Political Dysfunction Tax opportunity costs.

POLITICAL_SUCCESS_PROBABILITY.description: Estimated probability of treaty ratification and sustained implementation. Central estimate 1% is conservative. This assumes 99% chance of failure.

POLITICIAN_POST_OFFICE_CAREER_VALUE.description: Net present value of post-office career premium for average congressperson (10 years x $1M/year premium). Based on documented cases: Gephardt $7M/year, Daschle $2M+/year.

POST_1962_DRUG_APPROVAL_REDUCTION_PCT.description: Reduction in new drug approvals after 1962 Kefauver-Harris Amendment (70% drop from 43→17 drugs/year)

POST_WW2_MILITARY_CUT_PCT.description: Percentage US military spending cut after WW2 (1945-1947, inflation-adjusted: $1,420B to $176B in constant 2024 dollars)

PRAGMATIC_TRIAL_COST_PER_QALY.description: Cost per QALY for pragmatic platform trials, calculated from RECOVERY trial data. Uses global impact methodology: trial cost divided by total QALYs from downstream adoption. This measures research efficiency (discovery value), not clinical intervention ICER.

PRE_1962_DRUG_DEVELOPMENT_COST_1980_USD.description: Average drug development cost before 1962 FDA efficacy regulations, adjusted to 1980 dollars (Baily 1972)

PRE_1962_DRUG_DEVELOPMENT_COST_2024_USD.description: Pre-1962 drug development cost adjusted to 2024 dollars ($6.5M × 3.80 = $24.7M, CPI-adjusted from Baily 1972)

PRE_1962_PHYSICIAN_COUNT.description: Estimated physicians conducting real-world efficacy trials pre-1962 (unverified estimate)

PRE_1962_VALIDATION_YEARS.description: Years of empirical validation for physician-led pragmatic trials (1883-1960)

PRICE_OF_APOCALYPSE.description: The Price of Apocalypse: the annual cost of maintaining enough nuclear warheads to trigger nuclear winter once (~4,400 warheads, killing ~5 billion from agricultural collapse). Calculated as global nuclear spending divided by the nuclear winter overkill factor.

PRIZE_POOL_ANNUAL_RETURN.description: Canonical annual return used for PRIZE pool growth. Venture gross return + scale compression + crowd allocation alpha + home bias elimination. This is the structural pool return before contingent macro feedback loops.

PRIZE_POOL_HORIZON_MULTIPLE.description: Compound multiple for PRIZE pool growth over the resolution horizon (tied to the destructive economy 50% threshold year).

PRIZE_POOL_PARTICIPATION_RATE.description: Fraction of global investable financial assets that flow into the PRIZE pool. 1% central estimate parallels the 1% Treaty ask: 1% of your weapons money, 1% of your savings.

PRIZE_POOL_RETIREMENT_EQUIVALENT_PRINCIP.description: Secondary PRIZE seed benchmark: initial principal required so that the pool can make two referred votes retirement-equivalent on success at the modeled global coordination target. This is a stronger-incentive visible-pool benchmark, not the minimum capital required to make 50% participation credible.

PRIZE_POOL_SIZE.description: Terminal PRIZE pool size: global investable assets × participation rate × compound multiple over the resolution horizon.

QALYS_PER_COVID_DEATH_AVERTED.description: Average QALYs gained per COVID death averted. Conservative estimate reflecting older age distribution of COVID mortality. See confidence_interval for range.

RARE_DISEASES_COUNT_GLOBAL.description: Total number of rare diseases globally

RD_SPILLOVER_MULTIPLIER.description: R&D spillover multiplier: each $1 in directed medical research produces $2 in adjacent sector GDP growth (biotech, AI, computing, materials science, manufacturing). Conservative estimate; military R&D spillover produced the internet, GPS, jet engines. Medical R&D spillover already produced CRISPR, mRNA platforms, AI protein folding.

RECOVERY_TRIAL_COST_PER_PATIENT.description: RECOVERY trial cost per patient. Note: RECOVERY was an outlier - hospital-based during COVID emergency, minimal extra procedures, existing NHS infrastructure, streamlined consent. Replicating this globally will be harder.

RECOVERY_TRIAL_COST_REDUCTION_FACTOR.description: Cost reduction factor demonstrated by RECOVERY trial (traditional Phase 3 cost / RECOVERY cost per patient)

RECOVERY_TRIAL_GLOBAL_LIVES_SAVED.description: Estimated lives saved globally by RECOVERY trial's dexamethasone discovery. NHS England estimate (March 2021). Based on Águas et al. Nature Communications 2021 methodology applying RECOVERY trial mortality reductions (36% ventilated, 18% oxygen) to global COVID hospitalizations. Wide uncertainty range reflects extrapolation assumptions.

RECOVERY_TRIAL_TOTAL_COST.description: Total cost of UK RECOVERY trial. Enrolled tens of thousands of patients across multiple treatment arms. Discovered dexamethasone reduces COVID mortality by ~1/3 in severe cases.

RECOVERY_TRIAL_TOTAL_QALYS_GENERATED.description: Total QALYs generated by RECOVERY trial's discoveries (lives saved × QALYs per life). Uses global impact methodology: counts all downstream health gains from the discovery.

REGULATORY_DELAY_MEAN_AGE_OF_DEATH.description: Mean age of preventable death from post-safety efficacy testing regulatory delay (Phase 2-4)

REGULATORY_DELAY_SUFFERING_PERIOD_YEARS.description: Pre-death suffering period during post-safety efficacy testing delay (average years lived with untreated condition while awaiting Phase 2-4 completion)

RETIREMENT_EQUIVALENT_2_CLAIMS_TARGET_PA.description: Target success-side payout for two referred votes: what one representative annual savings contribution would become in a conventional retirement account by PRIZE resolution.

RETIREMENT_EQUIVALENT_CLAIM_VALUE_TARGET.description: Target value of one referred-voter claim when two claims are meant to match the conventional-retirement future value of one representative annual savings contribution.

SAFE_COMPOUNDS_COUNT.description: Total safe compounds available for repurposing (FDA-approved + GRAS substances, midpoint of 7,000-12,000 range)

SCALE_COMPRESSION_FACTOR.description: Diminishing-returns drag as the venture market expands ~15x (current global VC ~$300B/yr; Prize Fund deploys ~$4.7T/yr). More capital chasing deals compresses returns. Partially offset by market expansion (every viable idea gets funded, oligopolies face real competition). Point estimate is moderate; CI spans optimistic to pessimistic.

SEPT_11_DEATHS.description: Total deaths in the September 11, 2001 attacks. 2,977 victims (excluding 19 hijackers). Used as a reference point for scale comparisons.

SHARING_BREAKEVEN_ONE_IN_TREATY.description: Breakeven probability expressed as '1 in N'. Forwarding has positive expected value if you believe there is at least a 1-in-N chance the plan works. For context, lightning strike odds are ~1 in 1.2 million.

SHARING_BREAKEVEN_PROBABILITY_TREATY.description: Minimum probability that the plan works for forwarding to have positive expected value. EV > 0 when P(works) > cost_of_sharing / gain_if_works. Below this probability, not forwarding is rational. Above it, forwarding dominates. For context, the odds of being struck by lightning are ~1 in 1.2 million.

SHARING_OPPORTUNITY_COST.description: Dollar cost of 30 seconds at global average hourly income. The maximum downside of forwarding the message if the plan is impossible.

SHARING_TIME_MINUTES.description: Time to copy, paste, and send the recruitment message. 30 seconds.

SHARING_UPSIDE_DOWNSIDE_RATIO_TREATY.description: Raw ratio of upside (lifetime income gain if plan works) to downside (cost of sharing if plan is impossible). Not expected value; see SHARING_BREAKEVEN_PROBABILITY_TREATY for the probability threshold that makes forwarding rational.

SINGAPORE_GDP_PER_CAPITA_PPP.description: Singapore GDP per capita (PPP-adjusted). Among highest in world, demonstrating that lean government can coexist with prosperity.

SINGAPORE_GOVT_SPENDING_PCT_GDP.description: Singapore government spending as percentage of GDP. Less than HALF the US rate (15% vs 38%) yet achieves excellent outcomes through efficiency.

SINGAPORE_LIFE_EXPECTANCY.description: Singapore life expectancy at birth. 6.6 years LONGER than US (84.1 vs 77.5) despite government spending at less than half the rate.

SMALLPOX_ERADICATION_ROI.description: Return on investment from smallpox eradication campaign

SMALLPOX_ERADICATION_TOTAL_BENEFIT.description: Total economic benefit from smallpox eradication campaign

SMOKING_CESSATION_ANNUAL_BENEFIT.description: Estimated annual global economic benefit from smoking cessation programs

STANDARD_QALYS_PER_LIFE_SAVED.description: Standard QALYs per life saved (WHO life tables)

STATUS_QUO_AVG_YEARS_TO_FIRST_TREATMENT.description: Average years until first treatment discovered for a typical disease under current system. At current discovery rates, the average disease waits half the total exploration time (~443/2 = ~222 years).

STATUS_QUO_QUEUE_CLEARANCE_YEARS.description: Years to explore the entire therapeutic search space under current system. At current discovery rate of ~15 diseases/year getting first treatments, finding treatments for all ~6,650 untreated diseases would take ~443 years.

SUGAR_SUBSIDY_COST_PER_PERSON_ANNUAL.description: Annual cost of sugar subsidies per person

SWITZERLAND_DEFENSE_SPENDING_PCT.description: Switzerland's defense spending as percentage of GDP (0.7%)
